in_sanskrit.name: नवनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नव (Nav) meaning new, नाथ (Nath) meaning lord or protector. So, Navanath means 'New birth, New life', 'New protector', or 'New lord'. It is a significant name for a newborn child, symbolizing new beginnings and fresh starts.

in_hindi.name: नवनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: नव (Nav) meaning new, and नाथ (Nath) meaning lord or protector. So, Navanath means 'New birth', 'New life', 'New protector', or 'New lord'. It is a popular name in India and holds significant cultural and religious importance.

in_tamil.name: நவநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: நவ (Nav) meaning new, and நாத (Nath) meaning lord or protector. So, Navanath means 'New birth', 'New life', 'New protector', or 'New lord'. It is a unique and meaningful name for a baby boy in Tamil culture.

in_telugu.name: నవనాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: నవ (Nav) meaning new, and నాథ (Nath) meaning lord or protector. So, Navanath means 'New birth', 'New life', 'New protector', or 'New lord'. It is a popular and culturally significant name for a baby boy in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: नवनाथ
in_marathi.long_meaning:
नवनाथ हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। नव (Nav) - new
नाथ (Nath) - lord

in_bengali.name: नवनाथ
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ New Lord

नाथ (Nath) - lord
